description: This file defines a helper class PhpBrowserDriverHelper in the Helper namespace, extending Codeception's Module class. It provides methods to retrieve environment variables or configuration settings related to database connections, environment URLs, and authentication credentials used for testing SuiteCRM/ SugarCRM instances. The class helps configure test environment parameters for automated tests.

classes.name: PhpBrowserDriverHelper
classes.description: A helper class for getting configuration and environment variables for the PhpBrowser driver used in SuiteCRM testing, including database and authentication details.

methods.name: getConfig
methods.description: Returns configuration for the PhpBrowser module.

methods.name: getInstanceURL
methods.description: Retrieves the test instance URL from environment variables or defaults.

methods.name: getDatabaseDriver
methods.description: Retrieves the database driver type from environment or default.

methods.name: getDatabaseName
methods.description: Retrieves the database name for testing.

methods.name: getAdminUser
methods.description: Retrieves the administrator username for the suite.

methods.name: getPasswordGrantClientId
methods.description: Retrieves the OAuth password grant client ID.

methods.name: getPasswordGrantClientSecret
methods.description: Retrieves the OAuth password grant client secret.

methods.name: getClientCredentialsGrantClientId
methods.description: Retrieves the OAuth client credentials grant client ID.

methods.name: getClientCredentialsGrantClientSecret
methods.description: Retrieves the OAuth client credentials grant client secret.

methods.name: getEnvironmentVariableOrDefault
methods.description: Helper method that retrieves environment variable values or defaults to configuration values.
